:::{#def-prediction-rule}
#### Prediction rule

The **prediction rule** $\fitted$
that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$
produces from a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is the function that maps each covariate value $\predvar$
to the [prediction](estimation.qmd#def-prediction) that $\fitproc$ computes from $\predvar$ and $\trainset$:

$$
\fitted : \predvar \mapsto \fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}.
$$ {#eq-prediction-rule}

:::
